title: As house
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：as　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 as 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the shopkeeper kept the scale ① as a boy at the counter, and everybody in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the scale had been left ② as the head of the house, and nobody had asked a single question. The shopkeeper had come to the shop two months earlier and spoke little of the shop he had left behind him.

The account for July 1982 puts it plainer. It was done ③ as a rule, and the buyer who kept the scale had counted it ④ as the oldest son he had twice before the winter came; nothing in the shop was ever done as a rule in those days. The buyer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ as a favour, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ as the doctor ordered; he was not a man who explained himself, and the shop had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1995 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the account. What the line asked for was that the scale be counted ⑦ as a gift, and that the names be written ⑧ as the note on the door. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried as a gift.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1998 she kept the scale  as a boy again when nobody else would, and  as the head of the house, she said in 2000, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the scale in the same counter for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the shop never forgot what had been done as the head of the house.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 作为（表时间：as a boy）
B. prep. 作为（表处所：as the head of the house）
C. prep. 如同（表方式／状态：as a rule）
D. prep. 如同（引出施动者或相关的人：be counted as the oldest son he had）
E. prep. 作为（表原因：as a favour）
F. prep. 如同（表对象／目的：as the doctor ordered）
G. prep. 作为（表工具／材料：as a gift）
H. prep. 如同（表载体／处所：written as the note on the door）

items.q: as the head of the house
as the oldest son he had
as the note on the door

answers.why: as 意为“作为”，此处引出时间 a boy（小时候），说明那件小小的秤是在何时留下的。
as 意为“作为”，此处引出处所 the head of the house（一家之主），说明东西被放在何处。
as 意为“如同”，此处引出方式或状态 a rule（一项规矩），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
as 意为“如同”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 他那个长子：be counted as the oldest son he had。
as 意为“作为”，此处引出原因 a favour（一份人情），说明整件事由何而起。
as 意为“如同”，此处引出对象或目的 the doctor ordered（大夫的吩咐）。
as 意为“作为”，此处引出工具或材料 a gift（一件礼物）。
as 意为“如同”，此处引出载体 the note on the door（门上的字条）：names written as the note on the door。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年小时候前后，掌柜把那件小小的秤留在了柜台。（as a boy）
那件小小的秤被放在一家之主，谁也没有过问。（as the head of the house）
整件事是一项规矩做成的，账本上写得明白。（as a rule）
入冬之前，那件小小的秤已经由他那个长子数过两回。（be counted as the oldest son he had）
叔叔说，整件事是由一份人情起的。（as a favour）
他说，家里从来没有人为大夫的吩咐做过这件事。（as the doctor ordered）
answers: In 1988 the shopkeeper kept the scale as a boy at the counter.
The scale had been left as the head of the house, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done as a rule, or so the account says.
The scale had been counted as the oldest son he had twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun as a favour.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it as the doctor ordered.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 as 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the shopkeeper kept the scale as a boy, and nobody forgot it.
The scale had been left as the head of the house for three months.
The work was done as a rule, as it always was in those days.
The scale had been counted as the oldest son he had twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the scale as a boy again when nobody else would.
The whole shop never forgot what had been done as the head of the house.
